SELECT s.id AS spot_id, s.spot_name AS spotName, s.details AS details, s.business_hours AS businessHours, s.estimated_budget AS estimatedBudget, s.address AS address, s.gmap_url AS gmapUrl, s.website_url AS websiteUrl, s.closed_days AS closedDays, s.keywords, c.name AS categoryName, sc.name AS subCategoryName,
r.avg_rating AS averageRating, r.review_count AS reviewCount,
r.id AS review_id, r.user_id, r.comment AS comment, r.display_name AS reviewerName, r.created_at AS reviewDate, r.rating AS rating,
sp.id AS photo_id, sp.photo_url AS photoUrl, sp.display_order AS displayOrder
FROM spots s
LEFT JOIN sub_categories sc ON s.sub_category_id = sc.id LEFT JOIN categories c ON sc.category_id = c.id LEFT JOIN ( SELECT r.id, r.spot_id, r.user_id, r.comment, r.rating, r.created_at, u.display_name, AVG(r.rating) OVER (PARTITION BY r.spot_id) AS avg_rating, COUNT(r.id) OVER (PARTITION BY r.spot_id) AS review_count FROM reviews r INNER JOIN users u ON r.user_id = u.id WHERE u.deleted_at IS NULL ) r ON s.id = r.spot_id LEFT JOIN spot_photos sp ON s.id = sp.spot_id WHERE s.id = #{id} AND s.deleted_at IS NULL ORDER BY r.created_at DESC, sp.display_order ASC
